findings.instruction: Move the wood pile more than 30 feet from the house, or cover it completely with fire resistant material.
findings.reason: Frames show an uncovered stack of logs directly against the house wall.

findings.instruction: Replace the wooden fence near the house with fire resistant material.
findings.reason: Frames show a combustible wooden fence attached very close to the house.

findings.instruction: Remove dry brush within 30 feet of the house.
findings.reason: Frames show dead woody brush lying on the ground near the house.
